description: Every pinned version in this configuration lives in one of three places: the pre-commit hooks, the actions of the CI workflow, and the purls of the configuration's own Mason registry.
The workflow runs the StyLua version it reads off the pre-commit hook, so that one bump covers both.
Plugin versions are deliberately left out. `lazy-lock.json` is lazy.nvim's own lockfile and is rewritten by `:Lazy update`, so a bot editing it would only fight the plugin manager.

customManagers.description: Tools the own Mason registry installs from a GitHub release
Tools the own Mason registry installs with `go install`
Tools the own Mason registry installs from npm; a scoped name is written `%40scope/name` in a purl and looked up as `@scope/name`
Tools the own Mason registry installs from PyPI
Entries that build their purl from a version variable, and say so in a `-- renovate:` comment
Tools the own Mason registry builds with `cargo` from a commit of a repository that has no release, followed on its `main` branch

packageRules.description: A Mason bump is only picked up once the package is reinstalled by hand, so they arrive together in one pull request rather than one each.

Hold a release back for the same week `tools.mason-quarantine` and the npm, bun, pnpm and uv configurations do. Only datasources that date their releases are listed: a commit followed through `git-refs` carries no date to wait on.
